clips.title: The story
paras: On Red Cloud Mesa, Seer Graytongue guides young tauren through their first tribal trials. Near Camp Narache in Mulgore, he teaches them to honor the Earthmother before they enter the wider world.

Young tauren braves and spellweavers find Seer Graytongue atop Red Cloud Mesa. From there, he guides those setting out from Camp Narache through sacred steps, including the Rites of the Earthmother. Their trials test resolve against Mulgore’s harsh plains and dangerous beasts. Through them, Graytongue teaches honor, patience, and reverence, virtues every tauren carries into adulthood.
